workspace.text:

workspace.author: Alison
workspace.text: Thanks for checking, Brad. Before we report this as infeasible, can you please share Elena Soto and David Okafor's full busy times for the week? I want to cross-reference them with Priya and Marcus's calendars to make absolutely sure we haven't missed any overlapping slots. This will help verify our analysis before making a final determination.
